_comment: Overrides merged over packaging/meta.json by tools/build_var.py (all other fields, incl. licenseType, come from meta.json unchanged).
description: AIBody: gives an AI a virtual body. One plugin on the AI character: link to the external AIBody companion app (microphone, push-to-talk, engine settings) plus the body (speech with lip sync, expressions, morphs, gestures, poses, idle and breathing). Needs the companion app running. The default network link to the app (toggle "Network Active") needs VaM's setting "Allow Plugins Network Access" (User Preferences > Security); without it the plugin uses local files.
instructions: Select the AI character's Person atom > Plugins tab > Add Plugin > AddonPackages > d0n.AIBody.<version>:/Custom/Scripts/d0n/AIBody/AIBody.cslist. Then start the companion app. See https://github.com/d0n/vam_plugin
